description: This Java class defines an immutable command object used to update loan transactions within the Fineract loan portfolio module. It contains a single field for the date to be unassigned from a loan and includes a validation method to ensure the date is not null.

classes.name: LoanUpdateCommand
classes.description: An immutable command object encapsulating the data required to update a loan transaction, specifically the unassigned date, with validation logic to enforce data integrity.

methods.name: LoanUpdateCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with the specified unassignDate.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the unassignedDate is not null; throws a validation exception if validation fails.
